# rgpycrumbs

> Dispatcher-based analytical and visualization suite for chemical physics: eOn NEB/min/saddle plots, analytic surfaces, geometry, ORCA helpers, Click CLI.

Docs: https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/
Repo: https://github.com/HaoZeke/rgpycrumbs
PyPI / conda-forge: rgpycrumbs
Context7: /haozeke/rgpycrumbs

This file is a map of the published pages. It does not restate the API.
Use the public `rgpycrumbs` surface and the Click CLI. Do not import private `_` modules.

## eOn options

eOn configuration options are not listed here. The option schema is published with the eOn docs, not restated here: [eOn user guide](https://eondocs.org/user_guide/).

## Start

- [Home](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/): suite overview
- [Quickstart](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/quickstart): main features with short examples

## Tutorials

- [NEB reaction path visualization](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tutorials/neb-visualization): profiles, landscapes, and backends
- [Saddle search visualization](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tutorials/saddle-search-visualization): dimer and saddle trajectories
- [Minimization visualization](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tutorials/minimization-visualization): minimization trajectories
- [Rendering backends](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tutorials/rendering-backends): xyzrender, ASE, solvis, and ovito
- [First project](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tutorials/first-project): NEB output to an energy-landscape figure

## Tools

- [eOn tools](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/): eOn output, library plots, and CON I/O
- [con-splitter](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/con_splitter): split CON files
- [generate-nwchem](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/generate_nwchem_input): NWChem input from eOn
- [to-mlflow](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/mlflow): log an eOn run to MLflow
- [pimd-centroid](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/pimd_centroid): PIMD centroid
- [eOn plot TOML config](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/plot_config): plot.toml knobs, not the eOn option schema
- [plt-min](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/plt_min): minimization figures
- [plt-neb](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/plt_neb): NEB figures
- [plt-saddle](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/plt_saddle): saddle-search figures
- [ptmdisp](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/eon/ptmdisp): displacement plots
- [ChemGP tools](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/chemgp/): figures from ChemGP HDF5
- [plt-gp](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/chemgp/plt_gp): ChemGP figures
- [batch](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/chemgp/batch_command): batch command
- [Batch tutorial](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/chemgp/batch_tutorial): batch workflow
- [HDF5 schema](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/chemgp/hdf5_schema): ChemGP HDF5 layout
- [ORCA tools](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/orca/): ORCA helpers
- [ORCA input generator](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/orca/generate_orca_input): write ORCA input
- [Geometry processing](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/geom/): alignment and fragments
- [alignment](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/geom/alignment): structure alignment
- [detect-fragments](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/geom/detect_fragments): fragment detection
- [UMA AOTI packages](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/uma/): compiled UMA packages
- [prepare-aoti](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/uma/prepare_aoti): compile a package when none is cached
- [aoti-cache](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/uma/aoti_cache): cache layout and lookup
- [Surrogate-assisted searches](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/surrogate/): band, history, dimer, and campaign figures
- [Surface models](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/surfaces): gradient-enhanced kernels
- [Utilities](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/utils/): notebooks and workflow helpers
- [jupyter](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/utils/jupyter): Jupyter helper
- [Prefix tools](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/prefix/): prefix.dev package helpers
- [delete-packages](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/tools/prefix/delete_packages): delete prefix packages

## Siblings

- [chemparseplot](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/): parse and plot chemistry outputs
- [pychum](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/): ORCA / eOn input generation

## Install

```sh
uv add rgpycrumbs
# or
pip install rgpycrumbs
```
